title: The Vertical Codebase
partialText: A nice app architecture thought by Dominik: The Vertical Codebase. When component architecture came along, many started co-locating HTML/CSS/JS for a component, and it felt right. title: Building an Isolated Preview for AI-Generated HTML
partialText: An iframe with srcdoc feels like a safe place to render HTML a model wrote. It isn't. Three tests show how the preview can read your page, escape the frame, and phone home, and four layers of protection close each hole.

title: “I Redesigned VLC After 25 Years”
partialText: I watched this whole video by Juxtaposed, assuming it was a real redesign of the VLC player, but alas, it is not official. Nevertheless, it should be, and it’s a wonderful example of how much real human brainpower it takes to design something well.

title: Structured Output with TanStack AI
partialText: Part 2 of this intro to TanStack AI covers structured output: constraining the model's response to a Zod schema, then streaming that JSON in and rendering it while it's still incomplete.

title: Unlocking AI in Your Apps with TanStack AI
partialText: TanStack AI is a strongly typed set of libraries for adding AI features to your apps. Part 1 of this intro covers basic setup and prompting, streaming responses, persisting threads to your database, and resuming a response after a mid-stream refresh.

title: SVG “Linked Parameters” Will Change How We Do Icon Systems
partialText: Maybe we can get back to an img-based icon system?

title: Building a Fancy Scrollspy Using Modern CSS
partialText: Scrollspy navigation used to mean IntersectionObserver and a pile of JavaScript. With scroll-target-group, :target-current, and a little anchor positioning, a plain list of anchor links can highlight the current section all on its own.
